_scale_tiers_note: 0 is a real tier. Without it the ladder had no rung below 2, so a hard validation failure produced a DOWNSHIFT_ONE_TIER that recommended 2 - the same ceiling it started from - and publishing continued at full rate. 'Stop publishing' was inexpressible in this file. It is now tier 0.
publication_budget_law: All new authority URLs share one governed new-URL budget. Twin Agent repairs remain separate repair work and must follow exact acceptance/freeze law.
owner_override_note: Set to 600 on 2026-09-10 by the owner, explicitly and temporarily, to drain the standing backlog. This is a DECISION, not a derived tier: the ladder had been held at 2 since 2026-07-24 because every gate in health_snapshot read UNKNOWN and UNKNOWN never means PASS, so the upshift path was unreachable while pages cleared as SAFE_AUTOPUBLISH were released one per day. Lower it back to a governed tier once the backlog is drained.
